ValidationRule.description: US-114: Approval Status is set only by the approval process. Blocks a non-default value on create and any manual change on update (all users, API too). Bypass: custom permission Bypass_Equipment_Loan_Validation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Equipment_Loan_Validation), OR( AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Approval_Status__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, "Not_Submitted")) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Approval_Status__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approval Status is set by the approval process and cannot be changed manually.
